instruction: Please move the party night poster from Desktop to the Pictures folder on Ubuntu.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires moving the poster_party_night.webp file from Desktop to Pictures folder. The evaluator verifies both that the file exists in Pictures and no longer exists on Desktop (confirming move, not copy). No custom functions needed - reuses existing vm_command_line getter and exact_match metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies file move operation by checking both destination and source
Shell command properly validates that file exists in Pictures folder: [ -f /home/user/Pictures/poster_party_night.webp ]
Shell command properly validates that file no longer exists on Desktop: [ ! -f /home/user/Desktop/poster_party_night.webp ]
This correctly distinguishes between move and copy operations
Metric exact_match appropriately compares command output to expected success message
Expected value 'Moved successfully.\n' correctly matches the shell command output format
Evaluator provides complete coverage of the instruction requirement
Logic handles both success and failure cases through conditional shell command
